messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: P1 - Cygnus (tenant: cygnus-fin) elevated 5xx rate on dedicated-cygnus-1, region eu-west-2. Alert rule: model-5xx-rate > 5% for 3m. Pager routed to oncall-sre.

Jonas (oncall-sre): I’m on it. Seeing steady 5xx (~8%) and token-level latency spike. Impact: API errors for some customer requests (customers report failures, not just slow).

Lin (eng-runtime): Jumping in. Quick check: recent infra kernel module change? I see a spike in KV cache misses and TTL churn around 2034567800. Could be cache eviction race with latest runtime patch.

Aisha (eng-ml): Model-side: q8 quantized variant (cygnus pinned to redwood-econ-q8-7b) is showing repeated invalid KV fetch errors in logs. Non-quantized fallback seems healthy. Suspect the q8 runtime path mis-handling some encodings.

Jonas (oncall-sre): Priorities: 1) Mitigate customer impact ASAP (pin/route away from q8 variant), 2) Keep traffic flowing, 3) Postmortem later.

Lin (eng-runtime): Recommend immediate tenant-level override to safe variant (redwood-llama2-7b-q4f) and enable safe-variant fallback policy. I’ll prepare the command.

Aisha (eng-ml): Agreed. Reducing quantization for Cygnus should reduce 5xx and preserve quality. Small cost bump acceptable short-term.

Jonas (oncall-sre): @deploy-bot can you apply an override to route cygnus to safe variant?

deploy-bot: Received request. Running staged override. Command executed:
```
rictl override apply --tenant cygnus-fin --target-model redwood-llama2-7b-q4f --scope tenant --reason "Emergency: q8 variant 5xx spike" --expires 60m
```
Override applied (id=ovr-2034567890). Canary routing=10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4m.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (4m). Routing stable.

Jonas (oncall-sre): Monitoring metrics. 5xx dropping. K/V miss rate normalizing. :white_check_mark:

Priya (acct-manager): Heads-up I’ve notified Cygnus support contact (ops@cygnus-fin). Short note they received: "We detected elevated errors and routed your traffic to a stable model variant. We're monitoring and will follow up." Want me to join a quick call with the customer?

Sarah (prod): Yes please. We should be transparent: what we changed and next steps. Draft message: 
"Hi Ops team — we saw an elevated error rate tied to the q8 variant on your reserved pool. We routed your traffic to a stable variant (redwood-llama2-7b-q4f) as a precaution. No data exfiltration. Expect a brief quality check; we’ll follow up after root cause analysis."

Priya (acct-manager): Sending now.

Mateo (support): Customer acked, running a few smoke tests on their side. Reporting one failed edge case previously reproduced, but most flows clear.

Lin (eng-runtime): While traffic is stable, I'll roll back the recent runtime patch on dedicated-cygnus-1 (non-disruptive restart). Steps: 1) drain new requests, 2) revert kernel module (kmod v1.4 -> v1.3), 3) restart runtime, 4) validate KV miss rate. ETA ~15m.

Jonas (oncall-sre): Proceed. I’ll keep the override in place until we validate.

deploy-bot: Revert job queued: job-id revert-2034567890. Executing safe drain now.

deploy-bot: Revert complete. runtime restarted on dedicated-cygnus-1. Validation metrics look stable.

Lin (eng-runtime): Confirmed: KV misses back to baseline, 5xx ~0.3%. Looks like the kernel module change triggered a race under the q8 path.

Aisha (eng-ml): Machine-learning note: we'll run a compatibility test matrix for q8 variants on the reverted runtime before re-enabling.

Jonas (oncall-sre): Next actions (short):
- Keep tenant override in place for 60m (ovr-2034567890).
- Run full canary for q8 on a test pool with reverted runtime.
- Postmortem to capture root cause and runbook update.

Jonas (oncall-sre): Assigning follow-ups: Lin -> runtime revert verification & canary plan; Aisha -> q8 regression tests and model compatibility; Mateo -> coordinate customer validation and capture repro case; Sarah -> customer comms and postmortem owner.

Lin (eng-runtime): Will create canary job and link results in the postmortem.

Aisha (eng-ml): I’ll add test vectors, especially edge encodings that hit the faulty path.

Mateo (support): Got repro logs from customer, attaching to ticket INC-2034567.

Sarah (prod): I’ll start the incident doc and assign the postmortem. Rough timeline and blameless notes included.

Priya (acct-manager): Customer on brief call. They appreciate the quick routing fix and the proactive note. Asked for ETA on restoring q8; I promised updates after canary.

Jonas (oncall-sre): Closing immediate paging. If anything regresses ping me directly. Great job everyone. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: Incident P1 status -> mitigated. Override ovr-2034567890 expires in 45m unless extended.

Sarah (prod): Post-incident items: update runbook with explicit tenant override command and who to page for q-variant kernel regressions. Add a checklist for customer communication snippet.

Lin (eng-runtime): Will put a temporary guard in runtime to block q8 path if KV integrity checks fail, to force fallback instead of 5xx.

Aisha (eng-ml): Plan to coordinate with QA and infra to re-enable q8 only after automated compatibility tests pass and a successful canary on staging.

Jonas (oncall-sre): End of thread for now. I’ll extend the override if canary fails.

Mateo (support): Thanks all — capturing notes in INC ticket.

Sarah (prod): Postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/incidents/2034567890 (draft).

Priya (acct-manager): Customer follow-up scheduled for 0900 UTC.

Jonas (oncall-sre): :phone: handoff to next oncall in 30m — @Lin will be primary for runtime status, Aisha for model tests.

Lin (eng-runtime): I’m available for the handoff.

Aisha (eng-ml): I’ll stay on until tests finish.

Jonas (oncall-sre): Thanks team.
